campus_notes: Compiled 2026-09-14 from Boston College Residential Life's official floor-plan page, which is unusually generous: BC publishes approximate dimensions for every traditional room type (single, double, triple, lofted triple and quad) and approximate bedroom square footage for every suite and apartment layout, and names which of its 36 halls use each. Traditional rooms therefore carry BC's own ft x ft at high confidence; suite and apartment bedrooms, where only an area is published, show a representative rectangle of that area at medium confidence with the reason stated on the room. Suites and apartments are modeled per bedroom so occupant counts and layouts match cleanly. Beds are Twin XL.
